Collect hyperspectral data sets for Earth observation.
Description

The XCUBE-1 mission will collect hyperspectral datasets for Earth observation. Will support a Simera HyperScape100 camera with imaging/frame rate of 2600 Hz line rate and a spatial resolution of 4.8 m. The imager will have a GSD of 4.84 m/pixel. The spectral range is 442 nm – 884 nm.
